_note: SPEC-0057 AC-10 run 2, by the user on 2026-11-09, valid (window in front throughout: hiddenMs 0, stalledMs 0), http://localhost:8080/?loadHarness&domain=Order&rate=1000&duration=600&keys=20000&maxRows=2000. A real failure: the heap's per-minute minimum rose 48.9 -> 76.7 MB (+57%) and frame p95 reached 97 ms. Cause found: every render handed AG Grid a new columnDefs array and a new inline defaultColDef, so at one render per frame AG Grid rebuilt its columns about 60 times a second (StreamingBlotter.test.tsx 'hands the grid the same column definitions on every flush' failed against that code). Fixed by memoising columnDefs and a constant DEFAULT_COL_DEF; RowStore itself measured flat (4.0 MB after GC every minute of the same churn in Node). AC-9 here judges the 1,000/s run against the 2,000/s budgets and is not the AC-9 run.
